correctness.rationale: Diagonalization by normalized Bergman monomials gives exact eigenvalues. The rational first differences peak only at degree four, a strictly concave crossing and rational comparisons exclude all intervening modes, and geometric decay excludes higher modes. In the arbitrary-M family, outer-shell unimodality, two adjacent gaps asymptotic to h²/4, and logarithmic index splitting uniformly exclude every other monomial. The complete continuum and infinite-index arguments were reconstructed, including positivity, simple-vs-double top eigenspace, unique root, and local stability. Standalone exact rational and high-precision supplementary checks passed. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
